+"""project tracking fields (Wave 9 / Agent Epsilon)
+
+Revision ID: 0014_project_tracking
+Revises: 0009_id_sequences
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+Additive changes to `projects` table:
+- business_id (UNIQUE) — auto-generated SWA-2025-PRJ-NNN via id_gen
+- milestone — "Concept", "DBR", "Calculation", "Drawing", "Validation", "Closeout"
+- progress_indicators (JSONB) — e.g. {"design_pct": 30, "calc_pct": 10, "drawing_pct": 0}
+- status_updates (TEXT)
+- team_leader_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- project_owner_id (UUID FK→users.id)
+- notes (TEXT)
+
+Backfills business_id for any existing rows by allocating a contiguous
+block from the id_sequence counter and updating id_sequence.last_value
+so future calls do not collide.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+from sqlalchemy.dialects import postgresql
+
+
+revision = "0014_project_tracking"
+down_revision = "0009_id_sequences"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("business_id", sa.String(length=64), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("milestone", sa.String(length=50), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("progress_indicators", postgresql.JSONB(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("status_updates", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("team_leader_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("project_owner_id", postgresql.UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=True),
+    )
+    op.add_column(
+        "projects",
+        sa.Column("notes", sa.Text(), nullable=True),
+    )
+
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_team_leader_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["team_leader_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+    op.create_foreign_key(
+        "fk_projects_project_owner_id_users",
+        "projects",
+        "users",
+        ["project_owner_id"],
+        ["id"],
+        ondelete="SET NULL",
+    )
+
+    op.execute(
+        """
+        DO $$
+        DECLARE
+            yr INT := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::INT;
+            counter INT := 0;
+            seq_exists BOOLEAN;
+            rec RECORD;
+        BEGIN
+            SELECT EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM id_sequence WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr
+            ) INTO seq_exists;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                SELECT last_value INTO counter FROM id_sequence
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            END IF;
+
+            FOR rec IN SELECT id FROM projects WHERE business_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LOOP
+                counter := counter + 1;
+                UPDATE projects
+                SET business_id = 'SWA-' || yr || '-PRJ-' || LPAD(counter::TEXT, 3, '0')
+                WHERE id = rec.id;
+            END LOOP;
+
+            IF seq_exists THEN
+                UPDATE id_sequence
+                SET last_value = counter
+                WHERE type_code = 'PRJ' AND year = yr;
+            ELSIF counter > 0 THEN
+                INSERT INTO id_sequence (type_code, year, last_value)
+                VALUES ('PRJ', yr, counter);
+            END IF;
+        END $$;
+        """
+    )
+
+    op.execute("UPDATE projects SET milestone = 'Concept' WHERE milestone IS NULL")
+
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_business_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["business_id"],
+        unique=True,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_milestone",
+        "projects",
+        ["milestone"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_team_leader_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["team_leader_id"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+    op.create_index(
+        "ix_projects_project_owner_id",
+        "projects",
+        ["project_owner_id"],
+        unique=False,
+    )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_project_owner_id", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_team_leader_id", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_milestone", table_name="projects")
+    op.drop_index("ix_projects_business_id", table_name="projects")
+
+    op.drop_constraint("fk_projects_project_owner_id_users", "projects", type_="foreignkey")
+    op.drop_constraint("fk_projects_team_leader_id_users", "projects", type_="foreignkey")
+
+    op.drop_column("projects", "notes")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "project_owner_id")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "team_leader_id")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "status_updates")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "progress_indicators")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "milestone")
+    op.drop_column("projects", "business_id")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from datetime import date
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.service_agreement import ServiceAgreement
+
+
+def list_agreements(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    status: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int]:
+    query = db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+
+    if client_id is not None:
+        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.client_id == client_id)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(ServiceAgreement.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(ServiceAgreement.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def get_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return db.query(ServiceAgreement).filter(ServiceAgreement.id == agreement_id).first()
+
+
+def get_agreement_by_business_id(db: Session, agreement_business_id: str) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return (
+        db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+        .filter(ServiceAgreement.agreement_id == agreement_business_id)
+        .first()
+    )
+
+
+def create_agreement(
+    db: Session,
+    *,
+    agreement_id: str,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    service_name: str,
+    start_date: date,
+    end_date: date | None,
+    total_tokens: int | None,
+    billing_model: str,
+    status: str,

+) -> ServiceAgreement:

+ALLOWED_TOKEN_TRANSITIONS: dict[TokenStatus, set[TokenStatus]] = {
+    TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS: {TokenStatus.CLOSED, TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW, TokenStatus.CANCELLED},

+    TokenStatus.CLOSED: {TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW},
+    TokenStatus.CANCELLED: set(),
+}
+
+
+def can_transition_token_status(from_status: TokenStatus, to_status: TokenStatus) -> bool:

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid

+

+from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo, audit_repo, inquiry_repo
+from src.backend.models.inquiry import Inquiry
+from src.backend.models.service_agreement import (
+    AgreementStatus,
+    BillingModel,
+    ServiceAgreement,
+)

+    ServiceAgreementUpdate,
+)
+
+
+def list_agreements_service(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    status: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int, int, int]:
+    items, total = agreement_repo.list_agreements(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, client_id=client_id, status=status
+    )
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def list_agreements_by_client_service(
+    db: Session,
+    client_id: uuid.UUID,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[ServiceAgreement], int, int, int]:
+    items, total = agreement_repo.list_agreements(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, client_id=client_id
+    )
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def get_agreement_service(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    return agreement_repo.get_agreement(db, agreement_id)
+
+
+def create_agreement_service(
+    db: Session,
+    data: ServiceAgreementCreate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> ServiceAgreement:
+    inquiry: Inquiry | None = None
+    if data.inquiry_id is not None:
+        inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, data.inquiry_id)
+        if not inquiry:
+            raise LookupError(f"inquiry {data.inquiry_id} not found")
+
+    business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
+    agreement = agreement_repo.create_agreement(
+        db,
+        agreement_id=business_id,
+        client_id=data.client_id,
+        inquiry_id=data.inquiry_id,
+        service_name=data.service_name,
+        start_date=data.start_date,
+        end_date=data.end_date,
+        total_tokens=data.total_tokens,
+        billing_model=data.billing_model.value,
+        status=data.status.value,
+        notes=data.notes,
+    )
+
+    if inquiry is not None:
+        if inquiry.converted_to_agreement_id is None:
+            inquiry.converted_to_agreement_id = agreement.id
+
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="agreement.create",
+        entity_type="service_agreement",
+        entity_id=agreement.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        after_json={
+            "agreement_id": agreement.agreement_id,
+            "client_id": str(agreement.client_id),
+            "inquiry_id": str(agreement.inquiry_id) if agreement.inquiry_id else None,
+            "service_name": agreement.service_name,
+        },
+    )
+    agreement_repo.commit_agreement(db, agreement)
+    return agreement
+
+
+def update_agreement_service(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
+    data: ServiceAgreementUpdate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> ServiceAgreement | None:
+    agreement = agreement_repo.get_agreement(db, agreement_id)
+    if not agreement:
+        return None
+
+    before = {
+        "service_name": agreement.service_name,
+        "status": agreement.status,
+        "billing_model": agreement.billing_model,
+    }
+
+    if data.service_name is not None:
+        agreement.service_name = data.service_name
+    if data.start_date is not None:
+        agreement.start_date = data.start_date
+    if data.end_date is not None:
+        agreement.end_date = data.end_date
+    if data.total_tokens is not None:
+        agreement.total_tokens = data.total_tokens
+    if data.billing_model is not None:
+        agreement.billing_model = data.billing_model.value
+    if data.status is not None:
+        agreement.status = data.status.value
+    if data.notes is not None:
+        agreement.notes = data.notes
+
+    after = {
+        "service_name": agreement.service_name,
+        "status": agreement.status,
+        "billing_model": agreement.billing_model,
+    }
+
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="agreement.update",
+        entity_type="service_agreement",
+        entity_id=agreement.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json=before,
+        after_json=after,
+    )
+    agreement_repo.commit_agreement(db, agreement)
+    return agreement
+
+
+def delete_agreement_service(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> bool:
+    agreement = agreement_repo.get_agreement(db, agreement_id)
+    if not agreement:
+        return False
+
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="agreement.delete",
+        entity_type="service_agreement",
+        entity_id=agreement.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"agreement_id": agreement.agreement_id, "service_name": agreement.service_name},
+    )
+    agreement_repo.delete_agreement(db, agreement)
+    return True

+def update_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
+    data: InquiryUpdate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> Inquiry | None:

+
+    before = {
+        "status": inquiry.status,
+        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
+        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
+        "priority": inquiry.priority,
+    }
+

+    if data.inquiry_type is not None:

+    )
+    inquiry_repo.delete_inquiry(db, inquiry)
+    return True

+VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES = {s.value for s in InquiryStatus}
+
+
+def transition_inquiry_service(
+    db: Session,
+    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: InquiryStatus,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    *,
+    client_code: str | None = None,
+    client_primary_email: str | None = None,
+    service_name: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[Inquiry, "ServiceAgreement | None"]:
+    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
+    if not inquiry:
+        raise LookupError("inquiry not found")
+
+    if new_status.value not in VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid status: {new_status}")
+
+    before_status = inquiry.status
+
+    if new_status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED:
+        if inquiry.status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED.value:
+            raise InquiryAlreadyConvertedError("inquiry already converted")
+        missing: list[str] = []
+        if not client_code:
+            missing.append("client_code")
+        if not client_primary_email:
+            missing.append("client_primary_email")
+        if not service_name:
+            missing.append("service_name")
+        if start_date is None:
+            missing.append("start_date")
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError(f"missing required fields for Converted: {', '.join(missing)}")
+
+        assert client_code and client_primary_email and service_name and start_date is not None
+
+        from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo
+
+        business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
+        client, agreement = inquiry_repo.convert_inquiry(
+            db,
+            inquiry,
+            client_code=client_code,
+            client_primary_email=client_primary_email,
+            service_name=service_name,
+            start_date=start_date,
+        )
+        agreement.agreement_id = business_id
+        agreement.client_id = client.id
+        db.flush()
+
+        audit_repo.create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="inquiry.convert",
+            entity_type="inquiry",
+            entity_id=inquiry.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json={"status": before_status},
+            after_json={
+                "status": inquiry.status,
+                "client_id": str(client.id),
+                "agreement_id": str(agreement.id),
+            },
+        )
+        db.commit()
+        db.refresh(inquiry)
+        db.refresh(agreement)
+        return inquiry, agreement
+
+    inquiry.status = new_status.value
+    audit_repo.create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="inquiry.status_transition",
+        entity_type="inquiry",
+        entity_id=inquiry.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"status": before_status},
+        after_json={"status": inquiry.status},
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(inquiry)
+    return inquiry, None

"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

def _reset_tables():
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        existing = {r[0] for r in result}
        # sorted_tables is in dependency order (parents first); delete children first
        tables = [t.name for t in Base.metadata.sorted_tables if t.name in existing]
        # Use DELETE instead of TRUNCATE to avoid AccessExclusiveLock deadlocks
        # against idle connections from the SQLAlchemy pool.
        for tbl in reversed(tables):
            conn.execute(text(f"DELETE FROM {tbl}"))
        # Restart sequences
        if tables:
            seq_result = conn.execute(text(
                "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relkind = 'S' AND relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace"
            ))
            for row in seq_result:
                conn.execute(text(f"ALTER SEQUENCE {row[0]} RESTART WITH 1"))
        conn.commit()

import pytest

async def test_soft_delete_client(authed_admin_client):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "DelClient",
        "code": "DEL-001",
        "primary_email": "del@example.com",

    r3 = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/clients")

    assert "DEL-001" not in codes

    for i in range(3):
        r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={

    body = r.json()
    assert len(body["items"]) == 2
    assert body["total"] >= 3

    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert len(r2.json()["items"]) >= 1

        "role": "manager",

async def test_update_contact(authed_admin_client):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "UpdContactClient",

        "name": "Jane",
        "email": "jane@example.com",

    r3 = await authed_admin_client.patch(f"/api/clients/{cid}/contacts/{contact_id}", json={
        "name": "Jane Updated",
    })
    assert r3.status_code == 200
    assert r3.json()["name"] == "Jane Updated"

        "name": "DelContactClient",
        "code": "DCC-001",

        "name": "NoAuth",
        "code": "NA-001",

display.text:
from collections.abc import Callable
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.roles import Role, role_includes
from src.backend.core.security import decode_token
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.models.user import User

security_scheme = HTTPBearer()


def get_current_user(
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
) -> User:
    try:
        payload = decode_token(creds.credentials)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired token") from e
    if payload.get("type") != "access":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Wrong token type")
    user = get_by_id(db, UUID(payload["sub"]))
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not active")
    return user


def require_role(required: Role) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    def _checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:  # noqa: B008
        if not role_includes(Role(user.role), required):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient role")
        return user

    return _checker

# Task 01 (Agent Alpha) — Inquiry + Service Agreement Backend

## Stream scope
Own the "lead-to-contract" flow: Inquiries Sheet → Service Agreements Sheet. Also owns cross-cutting Stage-0 infrastructure (`id_gen`, `sequences`, migration `0009`).

## Reference
- Spec: `.specify/specs/wave-9/spec.md`
- Excel sources: `resourses/ERP Sheets/Inquiries Sheet.xlsx`, `resourses/ERP Sheets/Service Agreements Sheet.xlsx`

## Data model

### `inquiry` table (NEW)
| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID PK | SQLAlchemy default |
| inquiry_id | String UNIQUE | `SWA-2025-INQ-001` — generated via `id_gen.next_business_id("INQ", year)` |
| inquiry_date | Date | |
| inquiry_type | Enum(String) | "Design", "Audit", "Certification", "Consultation", "Other" |
| inquiry_source | String | e.g. "IIT", "IESK", "Client Direct", "LinkedIn" |
| client_name | String | (may differ from a final Client row) |
| requirement_summary | Text | |
| estimated_value | Numeric(18,2) INR | |
| priority | Enum(String) | "Low", "Medium", "High", "Urgent" |
| status | Enum(String) | "Open", "Contacted", "Qualified", "Converted", "Rejected", "On Hold" |
| owner | UUID FK→users.id | nullable |
| technical_lead | UUID FK→users.id | nullable |
| notes | Text | |
| converted_to_client_id | UUID FK→clients.id | nullable, set when status→Converted |
| converted_to_agreement_id | UUID FK→service_agreements.id | nullable |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | |

### `service_agreement` table (NEW)
| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| id | UUID PK | |
| agreement_id | String UNIQUE | `SWA-2025-SA-011` (3-digit zero-padded) |
| client_id | UUID FK→clients.id | REQUIRED |
| inquiry_id | UUID FK→inquiries.id | nullable |
| service_name | String | e.g. "INSUDESIGN", "ENERGY AUDIT" |
| start_date | Date | |
| end_date | Date | nullable |
| total_tokens | Integer | nullable (N/A for retainer) |
| billing_model | Enum(String) | "Monthly", "Milestone", "Per Token", "Fixed", "N/A" |
| status | Enum(String) | "Active", "Paused", "Completed", "Terminated" |
| notes | Text | |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | |

## Stage-0 infrastructure — ALREADY DONE by orchestrator
The orchestrator has already created these — DO NOT recreate:
- `src/backend/core/id_gen.py` (function `next_business_id(db, type_code, year=None)`)
- `src/backend/models/id_sequence.py` (`IdSequence` model, exported in `models/__init__.py`)
- `src/backend/alembic/versions/0009_id_sequences.py` (creates `id_sequence` table; down_revision=`5ccdf30815c3`)

You must IMPORT from these. Your migration `0010_inquiries_and_agreements.py` must have `down_revision = "0009_id_sequences"`.

## Files to create
- `src/backend/models/inquiry.py` (Inquiry model + InquiryType, InquiryPriority, InquiryStatus enums)
- `src/backend/models/service_agreement.py` (ServiceAgreement + BillingModel, AgreementStatus enums)
- `src/backend/schemas/inquiry.py` (InquiryCreate, InquiryUpdate, InquiryRead, InquiryListResponse)
- `src/backend/schemas/service_agreement.py` (ServiceAgreementCreate, ServiceAgreementUpdate, ServiceAgreementRead)
- `src/backend/services/inquiry_service.py` (CRUD + auto-generate `inquiry_id` via id_gen; transition to "Converted" creates Client + ServiceAgreement stub)
- `src/backend/services/agreement_service.py` (CRUD + auto-generate `agreement_id`; on create, link back to inquiry)
- `src/backend/api/inquiries.py` (router with: list, get, create, update, delete, transition-status)
- `src/backend/api/agreements.py` (router with: list, get, create, update, delete, list-by-client)

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.client import Client


def list_clients(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Client], int]:
    query = db.query(Client).filter(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            Client.name.ilike(search) | Client.code.ilike(search) | Client.primary_email.ilike(search)
        )

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Client.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, client_id: uuid.UUID) -> Client | None:
    return db.query(Client).filter(Client.id == client_id, Client.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    name: str,
    code: str,
    primary_email: str,
    address: str | None = None,
    city: str | None = None,
    state: str | None = None,
    pincode: str | None = None,
    country: str = "India",
    gst_number: str | None = None,
    primary_phone: str | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> Client:
    client = Client(
        name=name,
        code=code,
        primary_email=primary_email,
        address=address,
        city=city,
        state=state,
        pincode=pincode,
        country=country,
        gst_number=gst_number,
        primary_phone=primary_phone,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(client)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def update(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def soft_delete(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    client.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client

import sys

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, pool

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

import src.backend.models  # noqa: F401 - needed for Base.metadata
from src.backend.core.config import settings
from src.backend.db.base import Base

config = context.config
config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", settings.DATABASE_URL)

if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(
        url=url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    db_url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    assert db_url is not None
    connectable = create_engine(db_url, poolclass=pool.NullPool)
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata)
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

    query = db.query(Inquiry)

        query = query.filter(or_(Inquiry.client_name.ilike(like), Inquiry.inquiry_id.ilike(like)))
    if status:
        query = query.filter(Inquiry.status == status)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Inquiry.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return list(items), total

def get_inquiry_by_business_id(db: Session, inquiry_business_id: str) -> Inquiry | None:

        requirement_summary=requirement_summary,
        estimated_value=estimated_value,
        priority=priority,
        status=status,
        owner=owner,
        technical_lead=technical_lead,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(inquiry)
    db.flush()
    return inquiry


def commit_inquiry(db: Session, inquiry: Inquiry) -> Inquiry:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inquiry)
    return inquiry


def convert_inquiry(
    db: Session,
    inquiry: Inquiry,
    *,
    client_code: str,
    client_primary_email: str,
    service_name: str,
    start_date: date,
    agreement: ServiceAgreement | None = None,
) -> tuple[Client, ServiceAgreement]:

        address=None,
        city=None,

        pincode=None,
        country="India",
        gst_number=None,
        primary_phone=None,
        notes=f"Auto-created from inquiry {inquiry.inquiry_id}",
    )
    db.add(client)
    db.flush()

    if agreement is None:
        agreement = ServiceAgreement(
            agreement_id="__pending__",
            client_id=client.id,
            inquiry_id=inquiry.id,
            service_name=service_name,
            start_date=start_date,

    inquiry.converted_to_agreement_id = agreement.id

class InquiryAlreadyConvertedError(Exception):
    """Raised when caller attempts to re-convert an inquiry."""


def list_inquiries_service(
    db: Session,

def create_inquiry_service(

    data: InquiryCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Inquiry:
    business_id = next_business_id(db, "INQ", date.today().year)
    inquiry = inquiry_repo.create_inquiry(
        db,
        inquiry_id=business_id,
        inquiry_date=data.inquiry_date,
        inquiry_type=data.inquiry_type.value,
        inquiry_source=data.inquiry_source,
        client_name=data.client_name,

            "client_name": inquiry.client_name,

        },

def update_inquiry_service(

    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> Inquiry | None:
    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
    if not inquiry:
        return None

    before = {
        "status": inquiry.status,
        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
        "priority": inquiry.priority,
    }

    if data.inquiry_date is not None:
        inquiry.inquiry_date = data.inquiry_date
    if data.inquiry_type is not None:

    if data.inquiry_source is not None:

    if data.client_name is not None:
        inquiry.client_name = data.client_name
    if data.requirement_summary is not None:
        inquiry.requirement_summary = data.requirement_summary
    if data.estimated_value is not None:
        inquiry.estimated_value = data.estimated_value
    if data.priority is not None:
        inquiry.priority = data.priority.value
    if data.status is not None:
        inquiry.status = data.status.value
    if data.owner is not None:
        inquiry.owner = data.owner
    if data.technical_lead is not None:
        inquiry.technical_lead = data.technical_lead
    if data.notes is not None:
        inquiry.notes = data.notes

    after = {
        "status": inquiry.status,
        "client_name": inquiry.client_name,
        "inquiry_type": inquiry.inquiry_type,
        "priority": inquiry.priority,
    }
    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="inquiry.update",
        entity_type="inquiry",

        before_json=before,
        after_json=after,

    return inquiry

    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
) -> bool:

    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="inquiry.delete",

        entity_id=inquiry.id,

        before_json={"inquiry_id": inquiry.inquiry_id, "client_name": inquiry.client_name},
    )
    inquiry_repo.delete_inquiry(db, inquiry)
    return True


VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES = {s.value for s in InquiryStatus}


def transition_inquiry_service(
    db: Session,
    inquiry_id: uuid.UUID,
    new_status: InquiryStatus,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    *,
    client_code: str | None = None,
    client_primary_email: str | None = None,
    service_name: str | None = None,
    start_date: date | None = None,
) -> tuple[Inquiry, "ServiceAgreement | None"]:
    inquiry = inquiry_repo.get_inquiry(db, inquiry_id)
    if not inquiry:

    if new_status.value not in VALID_INQUIRY_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid status: {new_status}")

    before_status = inquiry.status

    if new_status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED:
        if inquiry.status == InquiryStatus.CONVERTED.value:
            raise InquiryAlreadyConvertedError("inquiry already converted")
        missing: list[str] = []
        if not client_code:
            missing.append("client_code")
        if not client_primary_email:
            missing.append("client_primary_email")
        if not service_name:
            missing.append("service_name")
        if start_date is None:
            missing.append("start_date")
        if missing:

        assert client_code and client_primary_email and service_name and start_date is not None

        from src.backend.db.repositories import agreement_repo

        business_id = next_business_id(db, "SA", date.today().year)
        agreement = agreement_repo.create_agreement(
            db,
            agreement_id=business_id,
            client_id=uuid.uuid4(),
            inquiry_id=inquiry.id,
            service_name=service_name,
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=None,
            total_tokens=None,
            billing_model=BillingModel.NA.value,
            status="Active",
            notes=f"Auto-created from inquiry {inquiry.inquiry_id}",
        )
        client, agreement = inquiry_repo.convert_inquiry(
            db,
            inquiry,
            client_code=client_code,
            client_primary_email=client_primary_email,
            service_name=service_name,
            start_date=start_date,
            agreement=agreement,
        )

        audit_repo.create_entry(
            db,
            action="inquiry.convert",
            entity_type="inquiry",
            entity_id=inquiry.id,
            user_id=actor_id,
            before_json={"status": before_status},
            after_json={
                "status": inquiry.status,
                "client_id": str(client.id),
                "agreement_id": str(agreement.id),
            },
        )
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(inquiry)
        db.refresh(agreement)
        return inquiry, agreement

    inquiry.status = new_status.value
    audit_repo.create_entry(
        db,
        action="inquiry.status_transition",
        entity_type="inquiry",
        entity_id=inquiry.id,
        user_id=actor_id,
        before_json={"status": before_status},
        after_json={"status": inquiry.status},
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inquiry)
    return inquiry, None
